item.title: Peterborough v Mansfield postponed
item.description: Our Sky Bet League One fixture away at Peterborough United on Saturday 28 March has been postponed due to our hosts having three international call-ups in their first team squad. The fixture will now be played on Tuesday 28 April (7.45pm kick-off). Tickets purchased for the original date will remain valid when Stags head to Weston Homes Stadium next month.

item.title: Team news: Stags v Northampton
item.description: Nigel Clough makes seven changes to the side that drew with Bradford in midweek. Kyle Knoyle, Ryan Sweeney, Jordan Bowery, Nathan Moriah-Welsh, Aaron Lewis, Joe Gardner and Victor Adeboyejo are replaced by Elliott Hewitt, Stephen McLaughlin, Frazer Blake-Tracy, Lucas Akins, George Abbott, Rhys Oates and Will Evans in today's team to face Northampton. item.title: Stockport v Mansfield rescheduled
item.description: Mansfield Town’s Sky Bet League One fixture away to Stockport County has been rearranged for Tuesday 21 April (7.45pm kick-off).The game was originally due to be played on Saturday 07 March at Edgeley Park, but was postponed due to Stags’ progression in the Emirates FA Cup.Tickets purchased for the original fixture will be automatically valid for the rescheduled game.

item.title: Youth report: Notts County U18 1-2 Stags U18
item.description: Set-piece goals from midfielder Ollie Taylor and captain Bobby Hassall handed Mansfield Town under-18s a 2-1 victory over rivals Notts County on Saturday to retain The Matt Salmon trophy. Hassall had a hand in both goals, teeing up Taylor to stab home from a first-half corner before doubling the young Stags’ lead himself four minutes from time.
